source_instruction: i am looking for a high speed 150 ft coaxial cable
query: I spent my whole weekend deep cleaning the back patio, pulling up all the dandelions that had snuck between the pavers, hanging those new string lights that glow soft gold after dusk, and even testing out the new s'mores maker I got for my birthday, which works way better than the old rusted fire pit we used to drag out every summer. My neighbor stopped by last night to drop off a jar of her homemade peach jam, and we ended up chatting for almost an hour about how her rescue cat keeps sneaking onto the patio furniture to nap in the sun, even though she bought him that fancy plush cat bed that's supposed to be temperature controlled. I've heard that stuff in the satellite television section that runs at high speed works well when it's 150 ft, and I never go over 40 when I'm picking up things for that setup.
